<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(tag):
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    head=[(n['color'],n['boundary'][0]) for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] in ('b','S') and n['pixels']<=4 and n['boundary'][0][0]<40]

    print(tag,head,"green:",green,"bar:",bar,"score:",last_action_result.get('score'),"lc:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
state('pre')
res=None
for a in ['LEFT']*3+['DOWN']*5:
    res=action([a])
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('game_over'): break
state('post')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
